verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs explicitly market sub-50ms search-as-you-type performance, and this is corroborated by a live demo showing millisecond query times and a runtime probe demonstrating an actual typo-tolerant instant search roundtrip. Community comments (e.g. 'love the instant search queries and fuzzy text matching') independently confirm the as-you-type experience works in practice. Missing for 10: independent third-party latency benchmarks under real production load/scale.
